title: Parallel DNA and RNA Extraction from Freshwater Samples Using Quick-DNA/RNA Microprep Kit
author: Christopher A Hempel

steps.title: Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Vortex the thawed filters/bead tubes using a Microtube holder on a Vortex-Genie.

substeps.instruction: Vortex for 40 min at max speed
Process no more than 18 tubes at a time to maintain vortexing speed and accuracy

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation and Supernatant Transfer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the bead tubes and collect the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge bead tubes for 1 min at 13,000 xg at room temperature
Transfer as much of the supernatant as possible into 2 mL tubes, avoiding the transfer of beads

steps.title: Lysis and Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Add lysis buffer to the samples and vortex.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of DNA/RNA Lysis Buffer to samples and vortex

steps.title: First Round of Column Filtration
steps.instruction: Filter the sample through Zymo-Spin ICXM columns in two rounds due to sample volume.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 800 µl (first round) or the remaining volume (second round) of samples into Zymo-Spin ICXM in a collection tube
Centrifuge for 30 sec at 13,000 xg at room temperature
Save the flow-through
Transfer filter columns into a new collection tube

steps.title: Ethanol Precipitation and Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA/RNA to Zymo-Spin IC columns using ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of 100% EtOH (800 µl for first round / 600 µl for second round) to the flow-through and mix well by pipetting 10x up and down
Transfer the sample into Zymo-Spin IC columns in a collection tube
Centrifuge for 30 sec at 13,000 xg at room temperature
If necessary, repeat the transfer and centrifugation for the remaining sample using the same columns in a new collection tube
Transfer filter columns into a new collection tube
Repeat the filtration and binding process (steps 5-9 of the original sequence) using the same columns

steps.title: Column Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the columns to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Remove unnecessary collection tubes and racks from the hood
Add 400 µl DNA/RNA Prep Buffer to columns and centrifuge for 30 sec at 13,000 xg at room temperature
Transfer columns to new collection tubes
Add 700 µl DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to columns and centrifuge for 30 sec at 13,000 xg at room temperature
Transfer columns to new collection tubes
Add 400 µl DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to columns and centrifuge for 2 min at 13,000 xg at room temperature to ensure complete removal of wash buffer

steps.title: DNA/RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA/RNA from the column matrix.

substeps.instruction: Transfer one column at a time into a 1.5 mL tube
Add 22.5 µl ZymoBIOMICS DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the column matrix
Let stand for 5 minutes
Centrifuge for 30 sec at 13,000 xg at room temperature to elute DNA/RNA in water

steps.title: Filter Column Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare Zymo-Spin II u-HRC Filter columns.

substeps.instruction: Place Zymo-Spin II u-HRC Filter columns in new collection tubes
Add 600 µl ZymoBIOMICS HRC Prep Solution
Centrifuge for 3 min at 8,000 xg at room temperature

steps.title: Final Sample Purification
steps.instruction: Transfer eluted DNA/RNA through the prepared filter columns.

substeps.instruction: Transfer one prepared filter column at a time into a 1.5 mL tube
Transfer the eluted DNA/RNA into the prepared filter column
Centrifuge for 3 min at 16,000 xg at room temperature
Aliquot 2.5 µl of each final sample into Qubit tubes
Clean an ice rack with bleach, EtOH, and Eliminase, then place final DNA/RNA samples on ice
Perform Qubit measurement using 2 µl of the aliquoted samples
Store final samples at -80°C
Prepare DNase Reaction Mix: for the number of samples plus extraction control and one extra buffer, mix 35 µl DNA Digestion Buffer with 5 µl DNase I
Wash all columns with 400 µl DNA/RNA Wash Buffer and centrifuge for 30 sec at 13,000 xg at room temperature
Transfer all columns into new collection tubes
Add 40 µl DNase I Reaction Mix directly to the column matrix
Incubate columns at room temperature for 15 minutes
